Name: Stone & Beam Sophia Contemporary Area Rug, 7' 6" x 9' 6", Grey

Complete your modern-style home decor with this beautiful rug. Muted colors create an attractive woven design that suits many interior-design styles, and the fringe accent provides added elegance. 7'6" x 9'6" 100% polypropylene Machine made 0.75 High
